purpose: second held-out 3D problem: singular clamped/free edges with quadratic elements; first 3D test of the post hoc singular-order extension
adapter_description: Clamped block in 3D: [0, 2] x [0, 1] x [0, 0.5]; face x = 0 clamped; face x = 2 loaded by a uniform dead traction (0, 0, -1); other faces free. Compressible neo-Hookean, E = 1000, nu = 0.3. The clamped face meets the free faces along four 90-degree clamped/free edges (plane-strain exponent lam = 0.7112) and at four vertices (3D vertex singularities, exponents not computed). 20-node hexahedra (torch-fem Hexa2, default reduced rule); levels (n_x, n_y, n_z) = k (4, 2, 1), k = 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 (h = 0.5/k); strategies at k = 4: x-grading toward the clamp, exponent 1.5 and 2.0. QoIs: strain_energy; w_tip = u_z at (2, 0.5, 0.5); mid_gk_avg_sxx = sigma_xx averaged with exp(-(d/0.15)^2) about (1, 0.5, 0.5); root_gk_avg_von_mises = von Mises averaged with exp(-(d/0.1)^2) about (0, 0.5, 0.5), on the clamped top edge; peak_von_mises = max von Mises over all Gauss points.

theory.caveat: the four vertices where two free faces meet the clamped face carry 3D vertex singularities whose exponents are not computed; they act on point neighbourhoods and are expected to affect the energy less than the edges, but may dominate the PEAK

stated_in_advance.default rules: every singular_order check INCONCLUSIVE (theory for degree-1 elements only); verdicts therefore INCONCLUSIVE where that check is required (strain_energy, the two Gaussian averages)
stated_in_advance.pre-asymptotic label: not expected to trigger for strain_energy

developer_expectations_posthoc.strain_energy: singular_order PASS (order 2 lam = 1.42 within 0.15) and convergence PASS with rate; MEDIUM confidence (vertex effect)
developer_expectations_posthoc.w_tip: convergence PASS with rate, fitted order >= 1.27
developer_expectations_posthoc.mid_gk_avg_sxx: convergence PASS with rate; singular_order PASS (order >= 1.27, pollution from the edges); MEDIUM confidence
developer_expectations_posthoc.root_gk_avg_von_mises: convergence PASS (band or rate); LOW confidence (weight centred on the singular edge)
developer_expectations_posthoc.peak_von_mises: convergence FAIL; located at the clamped face (x < 0.1) on the finest three levels; log-log slope negative; slope = lam - 1 = -0.289 within 0.15 with LOW confidence (vertices may give a steeper growth)
developer_expectations_posthoc.strategies: both graded strategies solve with min det F > 0; LOW confidence (the reduced rule failed on a strongly graded mesh in cylinder3d)
